rpc: JSON-RPC sendrawtransaction inside the container (docker exec, no published ports)
note: Keys are fresh random secp256k1 keys created for each run and discarded; the chain is ephemeral regtest state.

samples.title: Spending a mature coinbase output to a transparent address
samples.how: Regtest with default should_allow_unshielded_coinbase_spends = false. Mined 130 blocks to a fresh P2PKH key, then signed a v5 transaction that spends the height-1 coinbase output to a transparent output.
samples.config:
[network]
network = "Regtest"

[network.testnet_parameters]
should_allow_unshielded_coinbase_spends = false

[network.testnet_parameters.activation_heights]
Canopy = 1
NU5 = 1
"NU6.3" = 1

[mining]
miner_address = "tmMN6qmVqPSG98tr3J6DMMbtyR2afWZkJCn"

[state]
ephemeral = true

[rpc]
listen_addr = "127.0.0.1:18232"
enable_cookie_auth = false

response.message: failed to validate tx: WtxId("private"), error: transaction did not pass consensus validation: could not contextually validate transaction on best chain: unshielded transparent coinbase spend: OutPoint { hash: transaction::Hash("9951b554fb42555d60663c1011e5c6e0e894f09378c6f6717d7dec2f9f3050cf"), index: 0 } must be spent in a transaction which only has shielded outputs

samples.title: A correct v5 transparent spend (control case)
samples.how: Regtest with should_allow_unshielded_coinbase_spends = true. A v5 transaction with the NU6.3 branch ID spends a mature coinbase output with a correct ZIP 244 signature and a 10,000 zatoshi fee. It is accepted, which shows the signer is right and the failures below come from the one field each changes.
